name: folio
description: Turn a CV into a personal website that looks designed for that one person, not generated.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your CV into a personal website.
interface.longDescription: Turn a CV (PDF, DOCX, LinkedIn export or text) into a static personal website with its own art direction, self-hosted fonts, the SEO a personal page needs, and a LinkedIn announcement image and post. Nothing is invented: every fact comes from the CV.
defaultPrompt: Turn my CV into a website.
Make a personal site from this résumé.
Make my personal site look less generated.
